{
  "name": "vibecode-webgui",
  "version": "0.1.0",
  "private": true,
  "license": "MIT",
  "engines": {
    "node": ">=18.18.0 <25.0.0",
    "npm": ">=9.0.0"
  },
  "scripts": {
    "setup": "node scripts/setup-development.js",
    "dev": "node --require ./src/instrument.ts node_modules/.bin/next dev",
    "dev:simple": "next dev",
    "build": "next build",
    "start": "next start",
    "start:dd": "node --require ./src/instrument.ts node_modules/.bin/next start",
    "lint": "next lint",
    "type-check": "tsc --noEmit",
    "test": "jest",
    "test:watch": "jest --watch",
    "test:coverage": "jest --coverage",
    "test:unit": "jest --testPathPatterns=tests/unit",
    "test:integration": "jest --testPathPatterns=tests/integration",
    "test:ws": "jest --testPathPatterns=tests/integration/websocket",
    "test:e2e": "playwright test",
    "test:e2e:headed": "playwright test --headed",
    "test:k8s": "jest --testPathPatterns=tests/k8s",

"test:monitoring:security": "jest --testPathPatterns=tests/security/monitoring-security\\.test\\.(ts|js)$",
    "test:complete": "jest --testPathPatterns=tests/complete",
    "test:pre-commit": "./scripts/pre-commit-tests.sh",
    "test:synthetics": "datadog-ci synthetics run-tests -c ops/monitoring/datadog-synthetics.json",
    "test:monitoring:production": "jest --testPathPatterns=tests/production/.*monitoring.*\\.test\\.(ts|js)$",
    "test:monitoring:health": "jest --testPathPatterns=tests/unit/health-check.test.ts",
    "test:security": "jest --testPathPatterns=\"tests/security/.*\\.test\\.(ts|tsx|js|jsx)$\"",
    "test:fix": "npm run setup && npm install --legacy-peer-deps",
    "dev:cdn": "./scripts/setup-tailwind-mode.sh cdn && npm run dev",
    "dev:docker": "./scripts/setup-tailwind-mode.sh docker && docker-compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml up --build",
    "dev:docker:detached": "./scripts/setup-tailwind-mode.sh docker && docker-compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml up --build -d",

"tailwind:cdn": "./scripts/setup-tailwind-mode.sh cdn",
    "tailwind:docker": "./scripts/setup-tailwind-mode.sh docker",
    "tailwind:restore": "./scripts/setup-tailwind-mode.sh restore",
    "monitoring:setup": "npx tsx scripts/setup-datadog-monitoring.ts",
    "monitoring:health": "curl -s http://localhost:3000/api/monitoring/dashboard | jq '.health'",
    "monitoring:metrics": "curl -s http://localhost:3000/api/monitoring/metrics?config=true | jq",
    "test:performance": "node scripts/run-performance-tests.js",
    "test:performance:synthetic": "npx @datadog/datadog-ci synthetics run-tests --config ops/monitoring/datadog-synthetics.json",
    "test:performance:lighthouse": "npx lighthouse-ci autorun",
    "test:performance:ci": "BASE_URL=http://localhost:3000 npm run test:performance",
    "performance:synthetic": "BASE_URL=http://localhost:3000 npm run test:performance:synthetic",
    "performance:monitor": "curl -s http://localhost:3000/api/monitoring/dashboard | jq '.performance'",

"otel:setup": "npx tsx scripts/setup-opentelemetry.ts",
    "otel:config": "curl -s http://localhost:3000/api/monitoring/otel-config | jq",
    "otel:health": "curl -s http://localhost:3000/api/monitoring/otel-config?action=health | jq",
    "otel:metrics": "curl -s http://localhost:9090/metrics",
    "otel:test": "curl -s http://localhost:3000/api/monitoring/otel-config?action=status | jq",
    "docs:validate": "npx tsx scripts/validate-documentation.ts",
    "docs:stats": "npx tsx scripts/validate-documentation.ts stats",
    "docs:generate": "npx tsx scripts/generate-api-docs.ts",
    "docs:update": "npx tsx scripts/auto-update-readme.ts",
    "docs:fix": "npx tsx scripts/fix-documentation-examples.ts",
    "docs:build": "npm run docs:generate && npm run docs:update && npm run docs:fix && npm run docs:validate",
    "docs:index": "echo 'Documentation index available at docs/DOCUMENTATION_INDEX.md'",

"docs:consolidated": "echo 'Consolidated documentation available at docs/CONSOLIDATED_DOCUMENTATION.md'",
    "security:test": "./scripts/security-test.sh",
    "security:audit": "npm audit --audit-level=moderate",
    "security:fix": "npm audit fix",
    "security:monitor": "./scripts/security-monitoring.sh",
    "security:scan": "npm audit --audit-level=high && ./scripts/security-test.sh",
    "security:headers": "curl -I http://localhost:3000 | grep -E '(X-|Content-Security|Strict-Transport)'",
    "security:status": "curl -s http://localhost:3000/api/monitoring/security | jq",
    "perf:monitor": "curl -s http://localhost:3000/api/monitoring/performance | jq",
    "perf:health": "curl -s http://localhost:3000/api/monitoring/performance?action=health | jq",
    "perf:detailed": "curl -s http://localhost:3000/api/monitoring/performance?action=detailed | jq",
    "perf:cache": "curl -s http://localhost:3000/api/monitoring/performance?action=cache | jq",

"perf:database": "curl -s http://localhost:3000/api/monitoring/performance?action=database | jq",
    "ai:status": "curl -s http://localhost:3000/api/ai/management?action=health | jq",
    "ai:models": "curl -s http://localhost:3000/api/ai/management?action=models | jq",
    "ai:usage": "curl -s http://localhost:3000/api/ai/management?action=usage | jq",
    "ai:costs": "curl -s http://localhost:3000/api/ai/management?action=costs | jq",
    "ai:performance": "curl -s http://localhost:3000/api/ai/management?action=performance | jq",
    "db:validate": "./scripts/validate-database-config.sh",
    "db:deploy": "./scripts/deploy-database-migrations.sh",
    "db:setup": "psql $DATABASE_URL -f database/production-setup.sql",
    "db:status": "npx prisma migrate status",
    "db:generate": "npx prisma generate",
    "db:push": "npx prisma db push",
    "db:reset": "npx prisma migrate reset",
    "db:seed": "npx prisma db seed"
  },
  "dependencies": {
    "@ai-sdk/openai": "1.3.23",
